title: [3.0-beta7] Treatments screen issue
body:
Version 3.0-beta7

Hi, I noticed on treatments screen:
* on last tab there is an automation entry - temporary target to `5,0 mmol/L` but it is displayed as `90,0mmol/L`

And I suggest some enhancements:
* could we have there left/right swapping to switch the tabs as the main screen does?
* it would be nice on manual blood glucose entries to see also the value entered

![Screenshot_20211127-122608_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24793786/143679708-14f5aed1-377c-48ef-bc5f-1e15db6f8e9e.jpg)

After a time I can add screenshot where is (from the bottom) wrong automation target followed by manual target (this is ok). I have also NS Client (3.0-beta7) where I did set next target of 6.0 which is displayed wrongly with mg/dL.

After that I did some profile switches from NS client (seems ok) but after that there are many many entries in same minute (48 times), values seems in mmol/L but labeled with mg/dL.


![Screenshot_20211127-190215_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24793786/143716158-3c21be37-5db8-4233-a7a9-d9225545be06.jpg)


![Screenshot_20211127-190239_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/24793786/143708081-6b71dc25-ba90-4156-9186-480327626a5e.jpg)
